metadata.question: Did more forest area burn in Sakha in 2015 than compared to 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Sakha (Yakutia) region in Russia (approx. 62°N, 130°E) - Data: Use MODIS burned area data (MOD64A1 collection) which provides annual burned area - Dates: Compare 2015 vs 2021 - Alternative: Landsat burned area mapping if MODIS fails 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS burned area data already provides quality-masked burned pixels - No additional cloud masking needed; we're looking at burned area classification 3. Logic: - Extract burned area for Sakha in 2015 and 2021 - Compare total burned area (m² or hectares) - Valid Zero: If burned area is legitimately 0 in either year (rare but possible) - C1: No data found for one or both years - C2: Valid pixels but 0 burned area detected (unlikely for Sakha but check) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: 2015 burned area > 2021 - B: 2015 burned area ≤ 2021 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Define Sakha (Yakutia) region - approximate bounding box sakha_coords = [[[104, 60], [150, 60], [150, 76], [104, 76], [104, 60]]] sakha_geometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon(sakha_coords) # 2. Load MODIS burned area dataset (MOD64A1 - annual burned area) burned_area_dataset = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD64A1') # 3. Filter for 2015 burned_2015 = burned_area_dataset.filter( ee.Filter.calendarRange(2015, 2015, 'year') ).filter( ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 12, 'month') ).filterBounds(sakha_geometry) # 4. Filter for 2021 burned_2021 = burned_area_dataset.filter( ee.Filter.calendarRange(2021, 2021, 'year') ).filter( ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 12, 'month') ).filterBounds(sakha_geometry) # Check collection sizes size_2015 = burned_2015.size().getInfo() size_2021 = burned_2021.size().getInfo() print(f"2015 Images: {size_2015}, 2021 Images: {size_2021}") if size_2015 == 0 or size_2021 == 0: print("No MODIS data for one or both years.") print("C1") else: # 5. Merge monthly images into annual composites (take max to capture all burned pixels) burned_2015_annual = burned_2015.select('BurnDate').max() burned_2021_annual = burned_2021.select('BurnDate').max() # 6. Count valid burned pixels (BurnDate > 0 means burned) burned_mask_2015 = burned_2015_annual.gt(0) burned_mask_2021 = burned_2021_annual.gt(0) # 7. Calculate burned area (MODIS pixel = 500m, area = pixel_count * (500m)^2) pixel_size_m2 = 500 * 500 # 250,000 m² per pixel count_2015 = burned_mask_2015.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=sakha_geometry, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('BurnDate').getInfo() count_2021 = burned_mask_2021.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=sakha_geometry, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('BurnDate').getInfo() if count_2015 is None or count_2021 is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") else: area_2015_km2 = (int(count_2015) * pixel_size_m2) / 1e6 area_2021_km2 = (int(count_2021) * pixel_size_m2) / 1e6 print(f"2015 Burned Area: {area_2015_km2:.0f} km² (Pixels: {int(count_2015)})") print(f"2021 Burned Area: {area_2021_km2:.0f} km² (Pixels: {int(count_2021)})") if count_2015 == 0 and count_2021 == 0: print("No valid burned pixels in either year.") print("C2") elif area_2015_km2 > area_2021_km2: print(f"2015 had more forest area burned ({area_2015_km2:.0f} > {area_2021_km2:.0f})") print("A") else: print(f"2021 had more or equal forest area burned ({area_2021_km2:.0f} >= {area_2015_km2:.0f})") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define Sakha (Yakutia) region - approximate bounding box
sakha_coords = [[[104, 60], [150, 60], [150, 76], [104, 76], [104, 60]]]
sakha_geometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon(sakha_coords)

# 2. Load MODIS burned area dataset (MOD64A1 - annual burned area)
burned_area_dataset = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD64A1')

# 3. Filter for 2015
burned_2015 = burned_area_dataset.filter(
    ee.Filter.calendarRange(2015, 2015, 'year')
).filter(
    ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 12, 'month')
).filterBounds(sakha_geometry)

# 4. Filter for 2021
burned_2021 = burned_area_dataset.filter(
    ee.Filter.calendarRange(2021, 2021, 'year')
).filter(
    ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 12, 'month')
).filterBounds(sakha_geometry)

# Check collection sizes
size_2015 = burned_2015.size().getInfo()
size_2021 = burned_2021.size().getInfo()

print(f"2015 Images: {size_2015}, 2021 Images: {size_2021}")

if size_2015 == 0 or size_2021 == 0:
    print("No MODIS data for one or both years.")
    print("C1")
else:
    # 5. Merge monthly images into annual composites (take max to capture all burned pixels)
    burned_2015_annual = burned_2015.select('BurnDate').max()
    burned_2021_annual = burned_2021.select('BurnDate').max()
    
    # 6. Count valid burned pixels (BurnDate > 0 means burned)
    burned_mask_2015 = burned_2015_annual.gt(0)
    burned_mask_2021 = burned_2021_annual.gt(0)
    
    # 7. Calculate burned area (MODIS pixel = 500m, area = pixel_count * (500m)^2)
    pixel_size_m2 = 500 * 500  # 250,000 m² per pixel
    
    count_2015 = burned_mask_2015.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=sakha_geometry,
        scale=500,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('BurnDate').getInfo()
    
    count_2021 = burned_mask_2021.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=sakha_geometry,
        scale=500,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('BurnDate').getInfo()
    
    if count_2015 is None or count_2021 is None:
        print("Calculation returned None.")
        print("C3")
    else:
        area_2015_km2 = (int(count_2015) * pixel_size_m2) / 1e6
        area_2021_km2 = (int(count_2021) * pixel_size_m2) / 1e6
        
        print(f"2015 Burned Area: {area_2015_km2:.0f} km² (Pixels: {int(count_2015)})")
        print(f"2021 Burned Area: {area_2021_km2:.0f} km² (Pixels: {int(count_2021)})")
        
        if count_2015 == 0 and count_2021 == 0:
            print("No valid burned pixels in either year.")
            print("C2")
        elif area_2015_km2 > area_2021_km2:
            print(f"2015 had more forest area burned ({area_2015_km2:.0f} > {area_2021_km2:.0f})")
            print("A")
        else:
            print(f"2021 had more or equal forest area burned ({area_2021_km2:.0f} >= {area_2015_km2:.0f})")
            print("B")
